text.tspan: Shared identity / queued expiry / grant rotation
Lost replies / old workers / split publication
Caller binding / immutable scope / fresh incarnation
Bind its own proof of possession
Old worker cannot mint a grant
No authority change or external send
Read current grant and protected prefix
Rotate keys through the same CAS
